A metal figurine of the deity Priapus. He is facing forward with an obviously enlarged and erect penis. He has a short beard and is wearing a toga-style draped tunic that is knee-length but gathers at the waist where it is held by both hands above the waist to expose the genitals. His legs are positioned together, and he is wearing shoes.
